assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Yellow Sprite LLC / Wakefield Entertainment / Moonbug Entertainment 收购。Moonbug 是何时收购它的？Moonbug 由谁所有？
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（儿童动画）。
  7. 内容供应模式：原创／委托制作的 3D 动画。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Cocomelon 排名第 2 名，历史累计观看量约为 227B（2270 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Cocomelon 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COCOMELON – NURSERY RHYMES: COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UCbCmjCuTUZos6Inko4u57UQ
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbCmjCuTUZos6Inko4u57UQ
  • Handle: @CoComelon (also visible as /c/CoComelon)
  • Official website: https://www.cocomelon.com/
  1. OPERATOR & ACQUISITION CHAIN
  • Original creator/operator: Jay Jeon (Korean-American), who founded Treasure Studio, Inc., based in Irvine, California (Orange County). The channel was created under his sole ownership.
  • Parent company pre-acquisition: Treasure Studio, Inc. (Irvine, CA)
  • Moonbug Entertainment acquisition: Announced July 30, 2020; Wikipedia's Moonbug article records the purchase date as July 31, 2020. Moonbug paid $120 million for Cocomelon and Blippi together. See Variety (July 30, 2020) and Hollywood Reporter (July 30, 2020).
  • Candle Media acquisition of Moonbug: Announced November 4, 2021; closed November 2021. Deal valued at ~$3 billion. Candle Media was co-founded by former Disney executives Kevin Mayer and Tom Staggs, with financial backing from Blackstone Inc.
  • Current ownership chain: Candle Media → Moonbug Entertainment → Cocomelon.
  • NOTE: No evidence was found linking 'Yellow Sprite LLC' or 'Wakefield Entertainment' to Cocomelon in any source consulted. These names do not appear in Wikipedia, Variety, Hollywood Reporter, BusinessWire, Fortune, or any other retrieved source. The correct operator entity is Treasure Studio, Inc.
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Created: September 1, 2006, under username 'checkgate' (per Wikidata and Wikipedia). Two versions of the ABC song were uploaded that day.
  • Earliest still-public uploads (both Sep 1, 2006):
    a) 'ABC Song with Cute Ending' — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0fw3l1z9CUQ — 309M views, 331K likes
    b) 'ABC Song' — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yfZ29cVaaVQ — 34.6M views
  • Channel rebranding history: checkgate (2006) → ThatsMEonTV (2007–2013) → ABCkidTV (2013–2018) → Cocomelon (2018–present).
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Displayed country: United States (per Wikidata P17 and P495).
  • Original operating location: Irvine, California (Orange County), per Variety and Wikipedia.
  • Post-Moonbug: Moonbug is headquartered in Camden, London, with a Los Angeles office overlooking Television City. Candle Media is based in Los Angeles. Per LA Times (Nov 2024), CoComelon production team relocated partly to the UK.
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: English
  • Expanded content languages by 2021: Spanish, Portuguese (Brazilian and European), Mandarin Chinese, German, Arabic (per Wikipedia).
  • Additional languages per Wikidata official website metadata: Armenian.
  • Separate country-specific channels exist (e.g., Spanish Latin American, Portuguese Brazilian channels linked from main channel description).
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Children's animation targeting ages 2–5. Channel description: 'Our collection of original 3D-animated kids music videos.' Specializes in 3D animation videos of traditional nursery rhymes and original children's songs. Formats include standalone music videos, compilations, and livestreams.
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Original/commissioned 3D animation produced in-house by Treasure Studio (pre-acquisition), now under Moonbug/Candle Media. Videos feature proprietary character designs (JJ, YoYo, TomTom, Cody, Nina) and follow a staff-only ~100-page creative guide. Content is produced internally and distributed across YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, and 100+ other platforms globally.
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS
  • Most-viewed video: 'Yes Yes Bedtime Song' (1B+ views)
  • Early classics: 'ABC Song', 'ABC Song with Cute Ending', 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star' (first 3D video, April 2016)
  • Blockbuster: 'Bath Song | + More Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs' (3.2B+ views as of Sept 2020)
  • Spinoff series: 'It's Cody Time' (YouTube, May 2022), 'JJ's Animal Time', 'Nina's Familia' (Netflix, Sept 2023, bilingual English/Spanish), 'Cocomelon Lane' (Netflix, Nov 2023, narrative-driven), 'Cocomelon Classroom' (YouTube, Sept 2024, first live-action title)
  • Film: 'CoComelon: The Movie' (DreamWorks Animation/Universal, Feb 2027)

KEY STATS (as of Sept 2026):

  • Subscribers: ~202 million (3rd most-subscribed on YouTube)
  • Lifetime views: ~227 billion (2nd most-viewed channel per Communitrics snapshot)

UNRESOLVED: The identities and roles of 'Yellow Sprite LLC' and 'Wakefield Entertainment' remain unverified. No source links them to Cocomelon; they may be confused with other entities or refer to entities in a different jurisdiction/context.
